title: Portal of the Desert Sorceress
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a golden-armored sorceress standing on a stone platform with one arm raised toward a glowing purple portal. The portal reveals a silhouetted female figure. To the right, a floating green ethereal face with glowing blue eyes hovers above fiery red and orange flames. On the left, a large gnarled tree with colorful flowers frames a starry night sky over a desert landscape. A green staircase ascends toward the portal.
